query:
SELECT g.id, g.term_ms FROM edge_group g
                 JOIN address_pool p ON p.group_id = g.id
                WHERE p.cidr >>= $1::text::inet
                  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM stable_port s
                               WHERE s.address = $1::text::inet AND s.workload_id IS NOT NULL)
                  FOR UPDATE OF g
